subject: Telemetry continuity package — tapering retention & dashboard seat scale
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@finledger.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finledger.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry package questions + retention scaling

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — FinLedger is excited about Redwood's runtime and how the tracing dashboard surfaced cold-start latencies for our nightly batch jobs. Procurement asked me to follow up on two specific items before we take the quote to legal:

- Can you outline a pricing model that lets us keep high-fidelity tracing for the most recent 90 days, but then taper to a lower-resolution aggregated retention for 1–2 years?
- How do dashboard seat counts factor into the add-on pricing? We have ~12 engineers who need read/write dashboards, but only 3-4 daily power users.

I attached a simple spreadsheet with our expected volume distribution. Can Redwood provide a line item for a continuity/tapering plan and any bulk-seat discounts?

Appreciate a quick sketch so we can move this internally.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Observability, FinLedger

[attachment: finledger_tel_package_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 72KB)]

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@finledger.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry package questions + retention scaling

Alyssa — thanks for the note and the spreadsheet. Quick answers up front, then a proposed structure below.

Summary:
- Yes: we can provide a tiered retention profile (hot 90d full-trace, warm 10mo sampled/aggregated, cold 12–24mo compressed metrics).
- Seat pricing: base read seats are inexpensive; write/edit seats are charged at higher tier. We can offer a blended discount for your 12 engineers with a lock for 12 months.

Proposed continuity package (sketch):
1) Hot tier (0–90 days): full tracing + per-token/ingest charge as standard.
2) Warm tier (91–365 days): 10–20% sampling of traces + aggregated spans retained at 1-minute granularity; priced at 35% of hot unit cost.
3) Cold tier (366–1095 days): compressed span summaries & rollups, 5% of hot unit cost.
4) Dashboard seats: 3 power seats (full edit) + 9 collaborator seats (read + limited annotate) = blended rate.

I'll attach a draft quote and a simple example of monthly cost under three volume scenarios. Ben and Kim are looped for seat discounts and legal/contract implications.

Next steps: Ben will provide the discount matrix; Kim will confirm contract term language. If that looks ok, I can convert the sketch into a formal quote and a DocuSign packet.

— Logan

[attachment: redwood_quote_20280315.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@finledger.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry package questions + retention scaling

Alyssa / team — Ben here. A few pragmatic points on discounts and seat bundling: 

- We can offer a stepped commitment discount tied to a 12-month ingestion commit. The tiers I recommend: 10% at $X/month commit, 18% at $Y/month, 25% at $Z/month — I'll attach a matrix in the formal quote.
- For seats: standard approach is 1) 3 full admin seats, 2) collaborators at 30% of admin price. For blends above 10 seats we can drop collaborator rate to 20%.
- If you sign up for the continuity package with a 12-month commit, we'll waive the first month of hot-tier retention for onboarding (credits applied).

Operational note: the warm-tier sampling rate can be tuned per-service. We typically recommend keeping sampling higher for key endpoints and aggregated for internal batch jobs to control costs.

I'll produce calibrated numbers against the spreadsheet volumes.

-Ben

> > Alyssa — thanks for the note and the spreadsheet. Quick answers up front, then a proposed structure below.
> > [attachment: redwood_quote_20280315.pdf]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@finledger.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry package questions + retention scaling

Hi Alyssa,

I reviewed the numbers Ben sketched and spoke with legal about a simple addendum path. Two items from our side: 

1) Pricing guardrails: the warm/cold multipliers Ben suggested are what we typically publish; however we can cap the warm-tier billable ingestion at 50% of projected hot ingestion for the first 6 months to give you a runway while sampling is tuned.

2) Contract language: we will include a clear clause that defines "sampling rate" and an operational playbook for you to request adjustments without a formal amendment (one change request per quarter).

If those two items are acceptable I will generate the DocuSign packet. We can also include an optional AWS Marketplace listing (if you prefer procurement to route through marketplace).

Action required: Alyssa — please confirm whether procurement wants the marketplace route or direct contract. If marketplace, we will include the marketplace fee in the quote and coordinate the AWS onboarding (I copied marketplace-ops as FYI).

Thanks,
Kimberly
VP, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Procurement Team <procurement@finledger.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry package questions + retention scaling

Hi Kimberly / team,

Thanks — Procurement confirms FinLedger prefers the AWS Marketplace route for procurement (simplifies internal approvals). Please: 

- Add the marketplace fee to the quote and provide a marketplace listing link.
- Include the 12-month commit language and the 6-month warm-tier cap as proposed.
- Send the DocuSign once the marketplace flow is reflected.

We'll aim to complete review by 3/23 so Legal can start the marketplace acceptance.

Regards,
Procurement (FinLedger)
